snippet.title: Can You Reverse the Spin With Your Mind? 🌀
snippet.description:
Your brain can actually change how you perceive the direction of motion in this mesmerizing illusion. The sphere uses thousands of moving visual points that provide ambiguous motion cues, allowing your brain to interpret the same movement in different ways. When those visual cues become unclear, your perception can suddenly switch, making the sphere appear to reverse direction even though the underlying motion hasn't changed. Try focusing on one section and imagining the sphere spinning the opposite way—you may be able to trigger the illusion yourself. It's a fascinating demonstration of how your brain doesn't simply see motion; it actively interprets it.

snippet.description:
Can a mobile flashlight reveal hidden anatomy inside a simple paper drawing? 😱🔦

Welcome to Unmaiya Episode #45!

Pranesh discovers an amazing experiment where an ordinary black-and-white human body drawing appears to reveal bones, nerves and internal anatomy when a phone flashlight shines behind it! 🦴

But does this viral flashlight trick actually work?

Appa decides to recreate the experiment and test it for everyone!

Using two carefully aligned drawings — one showing the human outline and another showing internal anatomy — we explore how light passing through layered paper can create a surprising visual illusion.

No real X-ray technology involved, just a creative combination of paper, light and clever positioning!

Watch till the end to see the experiment and its result.

snippet.title: My Dogs Reaction To The 3D Optical Illusion Rug
snippet.description:
My Dogs Reaction To The 3D Optical Illusion Rug

I got a 3D optical illusion rug to test my dogs’ reaction… and I did NOT expect this!

Watch how my German Shepherd Tiger, my Golden Retrievers Leo and Nala, an our cat Meatball react when the floor suddenly looks like a real hole in the floor!
They had no idea if it was safe to step on it or not… and their reactions are priceless!

This 3D illusion rug creates a crazy visual effect that tricks both humans and animals — but seeing my dogs try to figure it out was next level funny. What's your favorite reaction? Let me know down in the comments!
